                               NOTICE OF RESULTS
                        PHOENIX AVIATION ADVISORY BOARD

Pursuant to A.R.S. Section 38-431.02, notice is hereby given to the members of the
PHOENIX AVIATION ADVISORY BOARD, and to the general public, that the
PHOENIX AVIATION ADVISORY BOARD will hold a meeting open to the public on
Thursday, May 21, 2026 at 3:00 p.m. located at Phoenix Deer Valley Airport, 702
W. Deer Valley Road, Phoenix, Arizona 85027 via WebEx.

Members could attend the meeting via teleconference, WebEx video conference, or in
person.

Agenda items could be taken out of order.

The results for the meeting were:
